message: Hi Alex, it's Aisha at Pearl Dentistry, interesting. What does this cost?
reply: Hi Aisha, thanks for replying! It's a flat $900 one-time fix pack covering the issues we spot in the audit (speed, mobile, broken links, that kind of thing). No guarantees on results, just honest fixes. After that, an optional $250/month care plan keeps things maintained. Want me to send the audit findings first?
